content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GMC Jalgaon Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Download the application form from www.gmcjalgaon.org or www.med-edu.in. Fill out the application form completely. Attach self-attested photocopies of all required educational and supporting documents. Submit the application in person or by registered post to the outward-inward branch of the GMC Jalgaon office. Do not send applications online. Make sure it reaches by 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for GMC Jalgaon Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in GMC Jalgaon Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 14 vacancies: 3 Anatomy, 2 Physiology, 1 Biochemistry, 1 Pathology, 1 Forensic Medicine, 1 Community Medicine (Preventive and Social Medicine) and 3 more posts.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for GMC Jalgaon Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (www.gmcjalgaon.org or www.med-edu.in) and send it to Inward-Inward Branch, Government Medical College, Jalgaon, by by post or in person, to reach by 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 40 years for open category and 45 years for backward class candidates. Relaxation: Backward Classes 45.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 1,00,000 for Anatomy, Rs. 1,00,000 for Physiology, Rs. 1,00,000 for Biochemistry, Rs. 1,00,000 for Pathology, Rs. 1,00,000 for Forensic Medicine.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: M.S./M.D./DNB in relevant subject with teaching experience as per NMC norms. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates must submit a no-objection certificate if currently employed. Candidates must execute a bond as required. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates who remain absent for a continuous long period when appointed.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Preparation of provisional merit list based on marks obtained in academic qualifications, experience, research papers, and other criteria (Annexure-A). Interview. Provisional merit list for interviews will be prepared out of 90 marks based on Annexure-A criteria and 10 marks for the interview.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Appointment is purely on a temporary contractual basis for 364 days. Services can be terminated at any time without prior notice.
